screening_decisions.reason: Randomized trial in adults with HF using a tablet-based system that delivers HF information and lifestyle advice (mHealth education), compared with usual care.
Parallel-group RCT in HF adding an educational website to usual care; web-based education likely accessible via mobile devices. Meets mHealth/web education intent at title/abstract screening.
Pilot RCT of a web-based self-care educational intervention for HF patients. Although device not specified, web-based education could be mobile-accessible; include at screening.
Randomized clinical trial comparing SMS-based follow-up versus telephone/regular in HF. SMS constitutes mobile-delivered content and likely includes educational/reinforcement messages.
Education delivered face-to-face, computer-based (likely desktop) and written materials; no mobile/wireless mHealth educational platform.
Nurse-led counselling with computer-based and written materials; not delivered via mobile/wireless mHealth platform.
Nurse-guided education plus facilitated telephone and in-person follow-up; lacks a mobile/digital educational platform.
Video education adjunct (likely in-hospital/DVD) rather than mobile/wireless mHealth delivery; no smartphone/tablet/SMS platform described.
mHealth system but non-randomized pilot; does not meet RCT design criterion.
Recruitment analysis; not an RCT of outcomes; mixed diagnoses (HF/HTN/dyslipidemia).
Pilot RCT of a web-linked monitoring/compliance device; desktop web focus and educational content unclear; not a clear mobile mHealth education intervention.
Proof-of-concept/field inquiry; not a randomized controlled trial.
Usability/descriptive study; not randomized.
Protocol only; intervention centers on collaborative care with home telemonitoring and phone-based support, not mobile app/SMS/web education.
RCT of collaborative care with home telemonitoring/self-management support; no mobile/wireless educational platform specified.
Design paper; intervention primarily phone-based collaborative care; not mHealth educational delivery.
Randomized field experiment with a desktop web resource (computers provided); not mobile/wireless mHealth education.
Education delivered via in-person/telephone motivational interviewing; no mobile/digital educational platform.
Population not HF-specific (CVD/high risk mixed); outside HF diagnosis inclusion criterion.
2:1 RCT in HF using a mobile phone-assisted case management program; outcomes include knowledge and self-efficacy, indicating educational mHealth content.
Telehomecare monitoring; lacks mobile/smartphone/SMS educational platform.
Telehealth via video/telephone systems; not a mobile/wireless mHealth education intervention.
Randomized telehealth (Health Buddy) continuation; non-mobile device and education not specified; outside mHealth education scope.
Pilot RCT uses internet-based videoconference group sessions and Fitbit; videoconference counseling is excluded and no automated mobile educational platform described.
Quasi-experimental (non-randomized); also desktop computer-assisted learning, not mobile-focused.
Development/feasibility work; not an RCT.
Provider-targeted email reminders to nurses; not patient-directed mHealth education.
Feasibility study; not randomized.
Design paper; mixed CAD and/or CHF population; not HF-only and mobile platform specifics unclear.
Systematic review; not a primary randomized trial.
Pilot RCT of adherence telemonitoring with telephonic support; monitoring/reminder focus without explicit educational content via mobile platform.
RCT with HF or COPD; mixed population and telehealth delivery not mobile-focused; education via mobile not specified.
RCT of reminder systems (pillbox vs smartphone app); reminders without explicit educational content; outside mHealth education scope.
RCT of remote medication monitoring; primary focus on adherence monitoring; no explicit mHealth educational content described.
Mixed chronic-disease integrated care (COPD, HF, diabetes) with varied designs; not an HF-only RCT of mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.
Despite the HF telemonitoring trial title, the abstract pertains to smoking-reduction recruitment; no HF mHealth educational content and telemonitoring (economic focus) is not mHealth education.

Web-based telemedicine with frequent reporting and surveillance; focuses on monitoring/communication rather than mHealth-delivered HF education.

Overview of systematic reviews/meta-analyses on home telemonitoring; not a primary RCT of mHealth-delivered HF education.
Economic model/meta-analysis of remote patient monitoring; not an individual RCT of mHealth-delivered HF education.
Systematic review/meta-analysis of implantable device telemonitoring; not an RCT of educational mHealth interventions.
IN TOUCH RCT compares ICT-guided disease management with/without telemonitoring; management/monitoring focus rather than mobile-delivered HF education vs usual care.
Systematic review of automated telephone voice messaging across conditions including CHF; not an HF-specific primary RCT of mHealth education.
Prospective analysis (n=15) of decision-support rule-sets in mHealth HF management; not randomized and not explicitly educational.
Telephonic health coaching in a mixed high-risk population; not HF-specific and not an RCT of mHealth-delivered HF education.
Randomized trial in sedentary young adults about heart-disease risk communication; not an HF patient population nor HF education for HF patients.
